template_name: Crusader Mk I Cruiser Tank Platoon
historical_context: Crusader tanks began arriving in Q2 1941 and equipped 7th Armoured Brigade. Fast but mechanically unreliable in early production batches. Used for mobile operations and exploitation.

Crusader Mk I.notes: Fast but mechanically unreliable. Light armor vulnerable to German guns.

strengths: Fast enough for mobile desert warfare
Good for flanking maneuvers and exploitation
weaknesses: Light armor vulnerable to German 50mm and 75mm guns
QF 2-pounder inadequate against heavier German tanks
tactical_notes.typical_deployment: Mobile operations, flanking attacks, pursuit. Best used in combined arms with other cruiser tanks. Avoid frontal assaults against prepared positions.

phase_6_data_source.notes: Increased from 30 in Q2 to 44 in Q3 as production increased
